method: Primary pages read directly. Publication dates are separate from review dates. Null dates mean the publication date was not verified. Summaries are original, not archived copies.

sources.title: Find and Buy with AI: Visa Unveils New Era of Commerce
sources.observation: Initial Intelligent Commerce announcement: agent-specific credentials, consumer limits, consented personalization and commerce signals. Announcement does not establish universal GA.

sources.title: Visa Intelligent Commerce developer overview
sources.observation: Onboarding, token provisioning, passkey-authenticated payment instructions, credential retrieval, network merchant/amount controls and commerce signals.

sources.title: Visa Introduces Trusted Agent Protocol
sources.observation: Developed with Cloudflare; published protocol complements ACP and seeks x402 interoperability. Partner feedback is not proof of deployed integrations.

sources.title: Trusted Agent Protocol overview
sources.observation: Merchant- and purpose-specific time-bound signatures; distinguishes commerce agents from malicious bots.

sources.title: Trusted Agent Protocol reference repository
sources.observation: README describes RFC 9421 signatures, registry, CDN verifier, merchant and agent components. Reviewed overview only; not executed or certified.

sources.title: Visa Opens the Door to AI-Driven Shopping for Businesses Worldwide
sources.observation: Intelligent Commerce Connect announced as a single integration via Visa Acceptance Platform with network/protocol/token-vault abstraction. Select-partner pilot at announcement; no verified universal GA.

sources.title: Stripe powers Instant Checkout in ChatGPT and releases Agentic Commerce Protocol
sources.observation: ACP co-developed with OpenAI; merchant retains order acceptance, tax, fulfillment and returns. SPT scoped to merchant and basket total.

sources.title: Stripe launches the Agentic Commerce Suite
sources.observation: Low-code multi-agent selling integration; product suite is not the protocol specification.

sources.title: Everything we announced at Sessions 2026
sources.observation: Suite expansion, Link agent wallet, MPP and SPTs; platform support and several other capabilities explicitly previewed. Google distribution described as coming soon.

sources.title: Agentic commerce
sources.observation: Seller ACP/UCP and machine MPP/x402 routes; agent embedding explicitly private preview at review.

sources.title: Shared payment tokens: Agents
sources.observation: Seller profile, currency, max amount, expiry, revocation and requires_action lifecycle. US, Canada and listed European countries; API examples use preview version. Network tokens may be provisioned through Visa Intelligent Commerce or Mastercard Agent Pay.

sources.title: Link Agent Wallet
sources.observation: Customer OAuth to Link API, separate from Stripe API keys; spend request requires customer approval. Agent payments for US/Canadian customers; financial insights for US customers.

sources.title: Agents and AI on Stripe
sources.observation: Current entry point recommends agent plugins bundling MCP and skills; machine-readable docs and skills catalog.

sources.title: Model Context Protocol
sources.observation: OAuth or agent API keys, environment-scoped sessions and tool approval. Documented future cutoff on 2026-10-31 for full-access secret keys and restricted keys without Agent tag.

sources.title: Agentic Commerce Protocol repository
sources.observation: README marks protocol beta; dated snapshot 2026-04-17 and separate unreleased directory. Latest dated version observed, not a universal production support guarantee.

sources.title: ACP 2026-04-17 changelog
sources.observation: Discovery, carts, feed push to agents, delegated authentication and version mismatch guidance. Changelog contains historical unreleased path wording; implementation must consult dated schemas.

sources.title: MPP integration
sources.observation: Stripe/Tempo MPP over HTTP 402; cards through SPTs and stablecoins. Card minimum USD 0.50, stablecoin minimum 0.01 USDC at review; account/geography requirements apply.

sources.title: UCP overview
sources.observation: Commerce capabilities and extension model; merchant retains merchant-of-record role. Homepage links latest and draft surfaces, which must not be conflated.

sources.title: Agent Payments Protocol
sources.observation: Current overview describes open/closed Checkout Mandates and Payment Mandates and cryptographically verifiable intent; not just tool access.

sources.title: MPP overview and protocol index
sources.observation: Challenge, credential and receipt model for machine payments; links HTTP and MCP transports. x402 interoperability does not imply identical wire contracts.

sources.title: RFC 9421: HTTP Message Signatures
sources.observation: HTTP component signing foundation. Signature verification alone is not user payment consent or guaranteed prevention of fraud.

sources.title: AgentCore Shopping Concierge README
sources.observation: README-level review: AgentCore, Strands, MCP, Amplify/React, Cognito and memory; Visa tokenization behind feature flag. Explicitly not production ready. No code audit or deployment performed.
